hooks.command: f=$(node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);const p=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||(j.tool_response&&j.tool_response.filePath)||"";process.stdout.write(p)}catch(e){}})'); case "$f" in *.js) npx --no-install eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
